Method of Attack: Remote code execution via maliciously crafted JWS token exploiting lack of type check on secretOrPublicKey parameter in verify() method
Arbitrary file write on target machine
Impacted Systems: Open source projects created by Microsoft, Twilio, Salesforce, Intuit, Box, IBM, Docusign, Slack, SAP, and many more
Attack Vector: Exploitation of the secretOrPublicKey parameter in jwt.verify() method by sending specially crafted object
Compromise of secret management process between app and JsonWebToken server
